title: The Beginning of All Battles
overview: A beer company employee is caught up in a game of wine after his father's death.

title: Prayers to a Fragrant Land
overview: Shizuku begins his search for the meaning of the vision he saw.

title: Thus Spoke the Will
overview: Shizuku begins his search for the first of the Twelve Apostles.

title: Made by the Hand of Man
overview: The first battle over the Twelve Apostles is held.

title: The Strange Man from the Wine Division
overview: A strange man transfers to the newly-founded wine division at Taiyo beer.

title: Bring Back the Smile from That Day
overview: Miyabi is reunited with an old love from school who wants to buy wine from Taiyo beer's wine division.

title: The Pegasus in the Heavens
overview: Shizuku gets help with Takasugi's challenge from Issei Tomine.

title: A Smile That's Mysterious
overview: A mystery author comes to Shizuku about a strange bottle of wine.

title: A Smile That's Refreshing and Healing
overview: The identity of the one who sent the threatening letter, as well as the Second Apostle, are revealed.

title: In the Great Flow of Time
overview: The battle for the Third Apostle begins, and a new member comes to the wine division.

title: A Large Hand Met in a Nostalgic Place
overview: The battle for the Third Apostle continues.

title: Take the Distant Path
overview: Louran's jealous rivals plot to separate her from Tomine.

title: You Remind Me of My First Love
overview: Shizuku and Tomine search for their first loves to win the next Apostle battle.

title: The Missing Goddesses
overview: Shizuku and Tomine work together to get back stolen wine.

title: Wine, Served with Mystery
overview: Tomine and Shizuku work together to appraise an old wine collection.

title: Beautiful Silver Goddess
overview: Tomine and Shizuku climb the Matterhorn in search of the Fifth Apostle.

title: A Voice, Strict But Gentle
overview: Tomine and Shizuku climb the Matterhorn.

title: Embraced by the Eternal Universe
overview: The battle for the Sixth Apostle begins.

title: A Pale Moon Shines in the Distance
overview: Tomine and Shizuku conclude the battle for the Sixth Apostle.

title: A New Hand, Shrouded in a Veil
overview: Shizuku heads to Australia in search of the Seventh Apostle.

title: Prayers and Wisdom Unending
overview: The identity of the Seventh Apostle is revealed.

title: Gentle Fragrance of Distant Days
overview: Shizuku prepares to give up the battle for the Apostles.
